name: local-cloud-agent
description: Local + cloud agent system scaffold (Electron desktop + shared protocols)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lca/tool-protocol && npm run build -w @lca/ws-protocol && npm run build -w @lca/control-api && npm run build -w @lca/cloud-runtime && npm run build -w @lca/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/tool-protocol/test/*.test.cjs packages/ws-protocol/test/*.test.cjs apps/control-api/test/*.test.cjs apps/cloud-runtime/test/*.test.cjs apps/desktop/test/*.test.cjs
